A portable cabin in South Delhi is a factory-built steel-frame cabin delivered ready to use, ideal for site offices, sales suites, security posts and quieter residential-society setups across Saket, Greater Kailash (GK), Vasant Kunj, Hauz Khas and Defence Colony. SAMAN Portable manufactures these units and dispatches them from our Greater Noida factory, so a standard cabin reaches South Delhi sites in roughly 3–5 days of transit instead of months of on-site building.

What a portable cabin costs in South Delhi — and what drives the price

There is no single fixed price because every cabin is built to order. The quote depends on a handful of factors, so it is easy to scope. For an accurate figure for your Saket, GK or Vasant Kunj site, send us the size and intended use and we will quote it.

  • Size: floor area in feet and number of rooms or partitions
  • Panel and insulation: standard wall panel vs ~50 mm insulated PUF sandwich panel
  • Fit-out: toilet, internal partitions, electricals, flooring and finish level
  • Delivery distance: transit from our Greater Noida factory to your South Delhi address

Delivery is charged at a ₹3,000 default rate, with most standard units in 3–5 day transit. Custom or fully fitted cabins take longer to build before dispatch.

Sizes and configurations buyers in South Delhi ask for

Because South Delhi sites are often tight and plots are at a premium, most buyers want a compact footprint that still works as a real workspace. Common configurations include:

  • Compact office / guard cabin: single-room unit for a security post or small site office
  • Sales or site office: larger cabin with a meeting area, often with a toilet and partition
  • Multi-room cabin: joined units for project teams during a construction or expansion phase
  • Cabin office with washroom: a portable cabin office configured with an attached toilet for longer-term site use

Each layout is built on the same steel-frame system, so you can relocate the cabin when the project moves.

How SAMAN portable cabins are built

Every cabin uses a mild-steel structural frame fabricated to IS 2062, finished with powder-coated steel and clad in pre-galvanised steel skin. Wall and roof panels are ~50 mm insulated PUF sandwich panels (40 kg/m³ minimum density), which is what keeps interiors usable through Delhi's hot summers and cold winters. GI roofing handles the monsoon. The result is a dry, factory-assembled structure that arrives finished rather than being built on site — a real advantage on congested South Delhi plots where wet construction, noise and debris are restricted.

Our quality system is certified to ISO 9001:2015, and SAMAN has been serving India since 2009, incorporated as SAMAN POS India Private Limited in 2019.

Delivery and installation across South Delhi

We supply portable cabins across South Delhi as a service area — including Saket, Greater Kailash (GK-I and GK-II), Vasant Kunj, Hauz Khas, Defence Colony, Lajpat Nagar, Malviya Nagar and Green Park. Units are dispatched from our Greater Noida factory, which keeps transit short and predictable for the NCR.

  • Standard cabins: 3–5 day transit after build
  • Customised / fitted units: longer build time before dispatch (typically a few extra working days)
  • Delivery charge: ₹3,000 default; final figure confirmed with your quote

Because South Delhi has narrow lanes in areas like Defence Colony and Hauz Khas, we plan access and offloading with you before dispatch. For a quieter residential-society site, the dry, low-noise installation is usually easier to get society NOC clearance for than conventional building work — though society and local permission rules vary, so confirm them for your specific block. Construction activity in Delhi-NCR can also be restricted during GRAP pollution windows (roughly October–February); dry-assembly factory-built cabins are generally not barred under those rules.

Why buy factory-direct from SAMAN

You buy from the manufacturer, not a reseller — so the specification, build quality and after-sale point of contact are all the same company. SAMAN has delivered 500+ projects across India. Each cabin carries our warranty terms: 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. (The 20–25 years is the engineered service life of the structure, not a warranty period.) Returns are accepted within a 7-day customer-paid window after delivery.

FAQs about portable cabins in South Delhi


How long does delivery to South Delhi take?

A standard portable cabin is in transit for roughly 3–5 days after it is built, dispatched from our Greater Noida factory. Customised or fully fitted units need extra build time before dispatch. We confirm the exact timeline with your quote so you can plan site access.


What decides the price of a portable cabin?

Price depends on size, panel and insulation type, fit-out (toilet, partitions, electricals, flooring), finish level and delivery distance to your South Delhi address. Because every unit is built to order, we quote per requirement rather than from a fixed price list. Send the size and use and we will scope it.


Do I need permission to place a portable cabin in South Delhi?

Temporary structures often sit under different rules than permanent building, but requirements vary by area and by residential society. We recommend confirming local and society rules for your specific block. A dry, factory-built cabin involves no wet construction on site, which usually makes society NOC and clearance simpler than a conventional build.


What sizes are available?

From a single-room guard or office cabin to larger sales offices and joined multi-room units. A cabin office can also be built with an attached toilet. All sizes use the same steel-frame system, so the unit can be relocated when your project moves.


How are the cabins built to handle Delhi's weather?

Walls and roof use ~50 mm insulated PUF sandwich panels on an IS 2062 steel frame, with GI roofing for the monsoon. The insulation keeps interiors usable through hot summers and reduces cooling load compared with an uninsulated structure.


What warranty do SAMAN cabins carry?

SAMAN cabins carry 5 years on the structural frame and base, 1–2 years on finishing, and an engineered service life of 20–25 years. Returns are accepted within a 7-day customer-paid window after delivery.

Get a quote for your South Delhi project

Tell us the size, use and your South Delhi location and we will scope a portable cabin for you. Browse the full range on our portable cabin range, or look at our portable cabin office if you need a workspace setup.

Call +91 62009 09435 · WhatsApp +91 62009 09435 · or use Send Enquiry for a quote and site advice.
